content:
We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id (integer) for the template that when applied to the molecule reproduces the reaction described: DIBAL-H reduction of ester to aldehyde? Wait description: DIBAL-H reduces esters and nitriles to aldehydes. Overall a carbon-oxygen bond is broken, and another carbon-oxygen bond order changes from 2 to 1, forming aliphatic hydroxyls functional group. So forward reaction: ester -> aldehyde? Actually DIBAL-H reduces ester to aldehyde, which then can be further reduced to alcohol? But description says forming aliphatic hydroxyls functional group, so product is aldehyde? Wait aliphatic hydroxyls is alcohol. So forward reaction: ester -> aldehyde? That forms aldehyde, not alcohol. But they say forming aliphatic hydroxyls, maybe they refer to product being alcohol after workup? DIBAL-H reduces ester to aldehyde, then hydrolysis gives aldehyde, not alcohol. However maybe they consider the reduction of ester to aldehyde, then further reduction to alcohol? Not sure.

We have precursors from previous step: answer from make_5_lvl2-apply_template-2 gave two precursors: ['C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO', 'COP(=O)(CC(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)OC'] That seems to be product? Actually those are precursors from applying a template to some molecule. The molecule we have is likely the product of DIBAL-H reduction? The given SMILES is C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO which looks like a cyclic acetal? Contains an aldehyde C=O? Actually C/C(=C/... )CO is an allylic alcohol? Hard.

We need to find a template that when applied to this molecule (as product) gives precursors that match the described reaction (break C-O bond, change bond order). The template should be one that transforms an aldehyde to an ester? Wait retrosynthetic step: we have product (aldehyde?) and we want to go back to ester (precursor). So template should be reduction of ester to aldehyde (forward). In retrosynthesis, we break the C-O bond of ester to get aldehyde. So we need a template that matches the product (aldehyde) and gives ester as precursor.

We have search results earlier: three templates returned. Need to find which one corresponds to ester -> aldehyde reduction. Look at mapped_rxn strings.

First result (reaction_id 1037371) mapped_rxn: looks complex with many atoms, includes [OH] etc. Hard to parse.

Second result (reaction_id 154901) mapped_rxn: includes O=C(-[O...])... seems like ester? The product side is [C:3]-[C:2](-[C:4])-[OH] which is alcohol? Actually that template seems to convert alcohol to ester? The retro template is [C:3]-[C:2](-[C:4])-[OH]>> O=C(-O-... )... So forward reaction (retro) is alcohol to ester? Not our case.

Third result (reaction_id 284777) mapped_rxn: 'C-C-O-C(-C)-[O;H0;D2;+0:1]-[C:2](-[C:3])-[C:4]>>[C:3]-[C:2](-[C:4])-[OH;D1;+0:1]' This is conversion of ester to alcohol? Actually left side is C-C-O-C... which is maybe ester? Right side is alcohol. So this template is reduction of ester to alcohol (full reduction). Not our case.

We need reduction of ester to aldehyde (partial). None of these seem to match.

Maybe need to search with functional_groups_broken = ["carboxylic esters"] and formed = ["aldehydes"]? Let's try.
